// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// Deliberately placed in the ONE module permitted to mutate anything, so that
// OPS-MUTATION-MODULE cannot fire and the classification itself is what refuses
// it. Written at src/lib/ops/reads.ts this fixture would pass for the wrong
// reason and prove nothing about PUBLIC_REFERENCE being read-only.
//
// The near miss the register invites: an operator screen that refreshes it.
// Establishment is PUBLIC_REFERENCE, which is read-only on purpose. Rows get in
// through scripts/gias-import.ts, run by a person, reviewable in a pull request.
// This is the shape docs/school-identity-launch.md refuses in so many words: a
// bulk write of twenty thousand rows from a web button, with no stated reason,
// no confirm step and no audit row.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function refreshRegister(urn, schoolName) {
  return db.establishment.upsert({
    where: { urn },
    create: { urn, name: schoolName },
    update: { name: schoolName },
  });
}
